questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully centered (around 00:08-00:10), exactly three pens are visible on the white surface.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the same end pointing down; none are flipped relative to the others.
The leftmost pen has a blue barrel, while the middle and rightmost pens have black barrels. They are not all the same color.
All three pens appear to have their caps on and are of similar length; no bare writing tips are exposed.
The board moves continuously from the left side of the frame to the right side without stopping, pausing, or reversing.

parsed.reason: The video shows three pens on the board, but one pen is blue while the other two are black, violating the requirement that all pens must be identical in color.

description: One pen differs in color from the other two.
